column6: Not read by btl_hit_reaction.c; unnamed in every other view of the 0x190 hit record (EftHitRec says def->unk6 or atk->unk1B).
EftHitRec and EftDetRec name +0x08 level (the stronger record wins a clash); here it is compared with BtlSuper_GetClashPower in BtlColl_TryDodge.
Non-zero takes the direction from the hit position and 1 blocks deflect/reflect/absorb, but EftHitRec only says it is bit 1 of the technique def flags; no single meaning.
BtlMemberGauge, HitGauge, ActGGauge and three more gauge views name +0x20 variant (model variant in use).
BtlCapiPose names pose+0x20 dispOfs (display offset rebuilt every frame by BtlMove_UpdateHoverOffset); BtlCtlPose calls it move; here its y is subtracted from the ground height.
Eight pose views (BtlMovePose, BtlCapiPose, BtlCtlPose, ActGPose...) name pose+0x80 dir, the unit direction of travel.
BtlMovePose, BtlCapiPose, ActGPose and three more name pose+0x90 pitch; BtlMove_SetHeading stores its pitch argument there.
BtlMovePose, BtlCapiPose, ActGPose and three more name pose+0x98 speed (metres per frame along dir); used here times 30 for the water surface test.
stg_collision.h puts StgColPoly contact at work+0x18060 and its first word is flags; BtlMoveContact is the same block; bits 0xC0 are tested here.
BobjHit (btl_obj_anim.h) and BtlTechObj name object+0xCAC hitCount, the hit windows of the motion; compared as ~hitCount with the current hit.
HitObj and BtlTechObj name object+0xCAD hitNo (BobjHit calls it hitIndex); HitObj is the view of the same C file.
Filled from BtlSuper_GetStepCount; btl_act_super.c compares the motion level with it minus 1 to find the last step of the rush sequence.
Filled from BtlSuper_GetLandingKind and passed as the kind to BtlAct_GetLandingAction when the victim is released.
Filled from BtlSuper_GetThrowPartnerStep; the sequence waits at this step for the extra object to load, and later steps play the partner animation numbered from it.
Step at which the victim model is reloaded when +0x4C is set (SetFormCurrent then BtlChange_RequestChara); the getter is called BtlSuper_GetLastStep, so the intended meaning may be wider.
Second argument (id) of BtlChange_RequestObject for the extra model of the sequence; from BtlSuper_GetThrowChara, -1 = none.
Costume argument of the same BtlChange_RequestObject call; from BtlSuper_GetThrowCostume.
Variant argument of the same BtlChange_RequestObject call; from BtlSuper_GetThrowGauge20 (gauge +0x20 is the variant).
Slot argument of the same BtlChange_RequestObject call; from BtlSuper_GetThrowObjectSlot.
Technique bit 0x400000: when set the released victim is turned (flag 0x94) by the two angles at +0x60 / +0x64, else they are 0.
Random 0/1 under technique bit 0x400: the victim leaves in flight mode with action 0xB (neutral) instead of the landing action; what the choice represents in play is not known.
Technique bit 0x100000: the attacker gets flag 0x8B and the victim 0x97 every frame, the pair BtlChars_UpdateHold uses to attach the held fighter to the holder.
Technique bit 0x800000: at the start of the caught action the victim is turned by pi in yaw and pitch; the modes 2 / 5 of BtlMove_TurnYaw / TurnPitch are not understood.
BtlSuper_GetFlagsA bit 0x2000000: a victim that died in the sequence goes to action 0xEB (waiting for a member switch) instead of landing; name is a reading of that one use.
1 for catch reaction 0x1E: the caught animation loops (BtlAnim_AdvanceLoop, sound 0x12) until flag 0xAF drops instead of playing once.
Technique bit 0x2000 with attacker variant 0: at the last step the attacker model is reloaded through BtlChange_RequestChara; which form it becomes is set elsewhere (BtlAct_SetFormCurrent).
Technique bit 0x80000 with victim variant 0: at step +0x1C the victim model is reloaded through BtlChange_RequestChara; same uncertainty as +0x48.
Technique bit 0x800: BtlChar_RequestPlaceRelative also runs for motion level 0 (otherwise only from level 1 on); only this one reader.
Technique bit 0x10000; copied to the victim but no reader found in btl_act_super.c or btl_char_api_1.c.
Set when the victim state has table bit 0x800; no reader found.
Technique bit 0x4000000: on leaving, the attacker is raised by its height instead of getting flight flag 0xE; purpose unclear.
From BtlSuper_GetThrowAngleA; added to the yaw to build react.turnYaw when the victim is released (local addYaw in btl_act_super.c).
From BtlSuper_GetThrowAngleB; becomes react.turnPitch (negated when not hit from behind).
Two-word array over +0x04 (reaction sub id in HitReact) and +0x08 (unnamed everywhere); not used in this file.
Two-word array over +0x10 and +0x14 (silent in HitReact); not used in this file, and one name cannot cover both.
HitReact and ActGReact name +0x18 scale and type it f32; this view types it s32 and only writes 0, so the type should follow.
HitReact and ActGReact name +0x24 turnPitch; zeroed here next to faceYaw (their turnYaw).
Two-word array over launchA / launchB of HitReact; not used in this file, one name cannot cover both.
Fighter +0xFE4: a countdown that raises flag 0x96 each frame (btl_char_action.c), set to 30 after queued damage; the meaning of flag 0x96 is not known.
Set to 3 together with the no-flinch reaction (same in HitReact); no reader seen.

BtlActIChr names +0xE10 skillKiRate (skill id 0x18); not used in this file.

Not used in this file and unnamed in BtlCapiBChr.

BtlCapiPose names pose+0x20 dispOfs (display offset: hover bob and shake); not used in these files.
